The '''Peace Park''' was a decorative garden and the location of the [[Memorial Shrine/Legends|Memorial Shrine]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]] on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].

==History==
[[File:Moj-TakeoverOnMandalore.png|thumb|left|300px|The forces of the Shadow Collective attack the Peace Park.]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a bomb placed by a [[Death Watch bomber/Legends|member]] of the violent [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] splinter group known as the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] severely [[Attack on the Memorial Shrine/Legends|damaged]] the Peace Park's [[Memorial Shrine/Legends|Memorial Shrine]] as [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] were walking through the garden.<ref name="TMP" />

During the [[Takeover of Mandalore/Legends|Takeover of Mandalore]], the Peace Park was one of the targets for the gangsters of the [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]]. [[Ziton Moj/Legends|Ziton Moj]] led a team of [[Black Sun foot soldier/Legends|Black Sun foot soldiers]] and [[Pyke/Legends|Pykes]] there, attacking civilians and [[Mandalorian Guard/Legends|Mandalorian police]] alike.<ref name="SoR">{{TCW|Shades of Reason}}</ref>
